subject: ExpressLane Summit — activation deliverables, logo placement & stage allocation
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@expressconf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Reynolds <mark.reynolds@avpartner.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: ExpressLane SOW + express lane activation request

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Attached is the current SOW reflecting the Gold sponsor package (ExpressLane Summit, 9/22-9/24). A few notes up front:

- We can confirm a 20-minute keynote/demo slot on the main stage on 9/23 if you commit to the Gold package by 7/20.
- Express lane activation (priority attendee check-in + branded rideshare booth outside the main entrance) is an add-on we can include. We typically charge $12k for that activation but can offer it for $7k when paired with a speaking commitment.
- Logo placement: hero logo on event website + 600x120 banner in main hall. We can offer a stage backdrop logo (small center-right) if you provide high-res SVG by 8/01.
- AV/tech: our AV partner (cc'd) will provide two wired mics, clicker, and streaming feed. Any additional requests are billed separately.

I've attached ExpressConf_SOW_v3.pdf for your review and marked the express lane add-on as Optional Line 5. Please confirm whether you want to: 1) include express lane activation at $7k, 2) confirm keynote slot, and 3) approve the logo placement described above.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Director, Sponsorships — Express Conf
[Attachment: ExpressConf_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@expressconf.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ExpressLane SOW + express lane activation request

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for sending the SOW over. Overall this looks good and the keynote timing works for us. A couple of asks and proposed tweaks before we sign:

1) Express lane activation pricing — can you hold the $7k concession if we commit today? We want to evaluate ROI on the activation (rideshare partner, branded check-in) but are open to the bundled price if it remains available through EOD tomorrow.

2) Logo placement — we need the hero website placement to be in the primary sponsor carousel (not just the standard sponsor grid). Can you confirm the carousel exposure and impressions estimate? Also request that the stage backdrop logo be at 1:9 ratio relative to the keynote backdrop (we'll provide exact SVG).

3) Speaking slot — we prefer the 20-minute format with a 10-minute live demo + 10 minutes of Q&A. Please confirm that AV will support a live demo with a local laptop HDMI feed and streaming capture. If possible, include one practice session on 9/22 afternoon.

4) Lead retrieval — please confirm availability of QR lead-scan at the booth and whether leads can be exported to CSV within 24 hours post-event.

5) Payment terms — request Net 30 from invoice, and inclusion of a one-time $5k credit for first-time Summit sponsors (this is conditional on approval from our RevOps team).

I've attached an internal note with our asks (RDW_Sponsor_Notes_20260712.docx). Can you push back on anything you can't accommodate and send the updated SOW?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW_Sponsor_Notes_20260712.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@expressconf.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ExpressLane SOW + express lane activation request

Marissa / Olivia —

I reviewed the numbers. Quick notes from the commercial side:

- $7k express lane concession is reasonable if we confirm the keynote now. Can we lock the concession through 7/16 EOD instead of tomorrow? That gives RevOps time to validate the $5k new-sponsor credit.
- If the practice slot on 9/22 is available, we accept the AV baseline but will ask for one additional wired mic and short rehearsal window (30 minutes) with the streaming tech. Please confirm respective costs if this exceeds the included AV scope.
- For lead retrieval: we'll need leads delivered in CSV and uploaded to our HubSpot import folder. Can we get a copy of the lead schema in advance?

If Express Conf can hold the $7k concession to 7/16 and confirm the carousel exposure for hero placement, we're comfortable moving forward.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, GTM Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@expressconf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ExpressLane SOW + express lane activation request (contract points)

Hi Olivia —

Looping in legal comments on the SOW. High-level redlines:

- Liability cap: request to cap liability at total fees paid (standard for us). Currently unspecified in v3 — please add.
- Cancellation: need a partial refund clause if the keynote is canceled by organizer with less than 30 days notice. Propose 75% refund of sponsorship fee if organizer cancels keynote within 30 days.
- Data: lead ownership must be our data; Express Conf may process but not retain beyond 90 days unless agreed. Also require that the lead CSV exclude any PI not consented for marketing.
- Trademark usage: logo usage limited to the event marketing and must be pre-approved on final artwork.

I can send a marked PDF if that helps. Once the commercial items (express lane concession and carousel confirmation) are finalized, we can route to DocuSign.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@expressconf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Mark Reynolds <mark.reynolds@avpartner.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ExpressLane SOW + express lane activation request — updated SOW and DocuSign

Hi team —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary of updates we've accepted and next steps:

- Express lane activation: we will hold the $7k concession through 7/16 EOD as requested.
- Keynote: 20-minute slot confirmed for 9/23 with a 30-minute rehearsal window on 9/22 afternoon. AV partner confirms one additional wired mic at no extra charge; streaming capture included. Mark, can you confirm the HDMI/local laptop feed and a short test at 3:00 PM on 9/22?
- Logo placement: hero placement confirmed in the primary sponsor carousel. We estimate 1.2M impressions across event pages during campaign period (pre-event + onsite week). Stage backdrop placement set to the requested 1:9 ratio; please provide SVG before 8/01.
- Lead retrieval: QR scan + lead CSV export within 24 hours. We will provide the lead schema before the event. PI handling as per the redline — Express Conf will not retain leads beyond 90 days unless agreed.
- Payment and credits: DocuSign will reflect Net 30. We've included a one-time $5k first-time sponsor credit (applied to the final invoice).
- Legal redlines: accepted with edits — liability cap set to fees paid, cancellation refund clause updated as proposed. Please review the attached updated SOW (ExpressConf_SOW_v4.pdf).

Attached: ExpressConf_SOW_v4.pdf (updated with your legal redlines). I also pasted the DocuSign link below for signature routing: https://www.docusign.com/en/examples/HB-2026-EXL-4023

If everything looks good, Marissa — please confirm and we'll route to signature.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Director, Sponsorships — Express Conf
[Attachment: ExpressConf_SOW_v4.pdf (PDF, 345 KB)]
